use.Text: I'm geared to go! How do I use this portal?

hello.Text: Hello and welcome! Step right this way and you will be on your way to the Shadowlands in no time.

Text: It is very simple, first I run a nano on you that will charge your body so the Shadowlands portal will function on you. Then you just walk into the swirling vortex out here on the ramp.
{delay 1}\nYou will then materialize in Elysium in the Shadowlands.
